Generated by scripts/generate-color-channel-oracle.py with system LittleCMS 2.19.
D65 sRGB primaries; independent channel gamma1/gamma2 combinations.
para profiles use ICC parametric function0. curv profiles use 257-entry monotonic tables.
The exact written ICC is reopened with LittleCMS before RGB16 -> sRGB8 conversion.
Relative colorimetric, NOOPTIMIZE|NOCACHE; alpha is independently rounded, never premultiplied.
oracle.json records source tuples, alpha, tag types and expected RGB128 midpoint.
For r=g=gamma1 and b=gamma2, RGB128 maps to about [188,188,137]; reusing red for blue gives188.
No moxcms code or result is used to generate the profiles or expected pixels.
ICC creation timestamps may change on regeneration; pixel oracles stay stable.
